modes.title: Classic Round of Lies
modes.description: The straightforward main show with no special rules.

rounds.title: Spotlight
rounds.cue: First round: smile warmly, lie convincingly.
rounds.inputHint: Come up with an answer that sounds like it belongs in an encyclopedia.
rounds.votingHint: The truth isn't always the most spectacular statement.

rounds.title: Suspicion
rounds.cue: Now everyone knows the rhythm. That's exactly what makes it dangerous.
rounds.inputHint: A good lie needs a tiny grain of credibility.
rounds.votingHint: Look out for the answer that sounds too polished.

rounds.title: Finale
rounds.cue: Final round: double points, easy excuses.
rounds.inputHint: The final bluff can turn everything around.
rounds.votingHint: Trust your instincts—or bluff with full intent.

modes.title: Showrunner Mix
modes.description: Each round gets its own live-show rule.

rounds.title: Bluff Chain
rounds.cue: The best lie from the last round becomes this round's rumor.
rounds.inputHint: Build on the last bluff—but don't let on that you know it.
rounds.votingHint: Who spun the old rumor into the cleverest new version?
secretTasks: Slip in a detail that sounds like it came from a real source.
Use no more than seven words—and still sound confident.
Pretend you've always known this fact.

rounds.title: Hot Trail
rounds.cue: This time, every false answer needs a number as a fake piece of evidence.
rounds.inputHint: Include at least one number. The more unnecessarily precise, the more suspicious.
rounds.votingHint: Which number sounds most like a made-up statistic?
secretTasks: Make up a suspiciously precise number.
Claim you counted the number yourself.
Give your number a completely unnecessary decimal place.

rounds.title: Double Truth
rounds.cue: In the finale, it's not just knowledge that counts, but also trusting your instincts.
rounds.inputHint: Write a strong lie and deliberately trust your gut when voting.
rounds.votingHint: Confidence above 70 percent can trigger the showrunner bonus today.
rounds.revealCue: Two things count: the truth and the courage to trust it.
secretTasks: Vote for the truth only if you have the courage to do so.
Don't let a boring answer fool you.
Play the skeptic—until you're truly convinced.
